title: On Attaining the age of ninety
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：attain　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the foreman ① attained the age of ninety for the whole place, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② attains the age of ninety without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ attain the age of ninety at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ attained the age of ninety before — a line in the sheet for May 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Attaining the age of ninety for the whole place, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ attain the necessary permission without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Attain the necessary permission at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ attains the necessary permission for the whole place every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply  attained the age of ninety again when nobody else would.

To attain the age of ninety, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody attains the age of ninety without a word of thanks again and somebody must attain the age of ninety for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 达到（一般过去式 attained the age of ninety：1949 年工头头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 达到（一般现在 attains the age of ninety：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 达到（不定式 to attain the age of ninety：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 达到（过去完成时 had attained the age of ninety：1943 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 达到（动名词 attaining the age of ninety 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 取得（attain the necessary permission：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去取得那份必不可少的许可）
G. v. 取得（attain the necessary permission：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 达到（后段两处：新来的工人照例 attains the necessary permission，而母亲又一次 attained the age of ninety）

items.q: to attain the age of ninety
attained the age of ninety before
attain the necessary permission without a word of thanks
attain the necessary permission at once
attains the necessary permission for the whole place

answers.why: attain 意为“达到”，1949 年工头替所有人达到九十岁，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 attained。
attain 意为“达到”，自那以后工头不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 attains。
attain 意为“达到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯达到九十岁”，此处为不定式 to attain the age of ninety。
attain 意为“达到”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人达到过，故用过去完成时 had attained。
attain 意为“达到”，工头说“达到九十岁这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 attaining the age of ninety 作主语。
attain 意为“取得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去取得那份必不可少的许可”，should ever 之后用原形 attain the necessary permission。
attain 意为“取得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻取得那份必不可少的许可（attain the necessary permission at once），以后再也不要提起。
attain 意为“达到”，新来的工人每个班次都照例取得那份必不可少的许可，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 attains。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，工头替所有人达到九十岁；工地里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（attained the age of ninety）
多年以后，工头仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（attains the age of ninety）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯达到九十岁这件事本身。（to attain the age of ninety）
早在 1943 年就有人达到九十岁，五月那天施工单上的一行字就是证据。（had attained the age of ninety）
工头说过，替所有人达到九十岁这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（attaining the age of ninety 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻取得那份必不可少的许可，以后再也不要提起。（attain the necessary permission，祈使句）
answers: In 1949 the foreman attained the age of ninety for the whole place, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three shifts on, the foreman still attains the age of ninety without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to attain the age of ninety at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had attained the age of ninety long before 1956, and the line in the sheet for May proves it.
Attaining the age of ninety for the whole place, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Attain the necessary permission at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 attain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the foreman attained the age of ninety for the whole place, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman attains the age of ninety without a word of thanks whenever the site asks.
Attaining the age of ninety for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever attain the necessary permission without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site attains the necessary permission for the whole place every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother attained the age of ninety again, and the site remembered that half.
